featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

Impact of Dabbawala Enterprises Limited

• Opening of Bank accounts of Dabbawalas and bringing them in the formal economy.
• Now customers make payments in the bank accounts of the company and at the end of the month, the company transfers money in the Bank account of Dabbawala by deducting statuary deductions such as TDS, GST, etc.
• Now Dabbawalas have legal income proof and access to all kinds of credit facility.

For inquiries, contact us at info@dabbawala.net

Corporate Social Responsibility
(CSR)

Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited treats itself as an integral part of the society. We are always looking forward to help the society in every possible way. We work with NGOs, civil society and social entrepreneurs to be the change agent and bring out the positive changes in the society we live in. In the events of natural calamities like flood, earth quake and other life threatening situations we come forward and help the society.

Mission And Vision
Mission
Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited has a grand mission to create a world free of hunger and diseases by providing high quality and tasty food to the citizens of the world.

Vision
Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited has vision to be a global food company operating under the entire value chain of research & development, production, distribution and marketing of high quality food products that increase the quality of life of its consumers.

Values
At Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited we are guided by the traditional values of honesty, integrity, service and dedication along with the modern values like speed of service, customer focus, technology, innovation and globalization.

Ethics
Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited aspires to be a highly ethical company following the traditional ethical principles and conducting business is most honest, trustworthy and ethical way.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Medi Claim Policy
Dabbawalas have to work hard to ensure that the right tiffin box reach the right customer at right time. This job involves working in all weather conditions like high rain, cold and extreme summer. Due to this, the chance of falling sick increases tremendously. In case of high medical and hospitalization bill, the financial condition of Dabbawala is severely affected.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers Rs. 100,000 (1 Lakhs) medi claim policy to Dabbawalas covering their entire family. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of falling sick or hospitalization, the Dabbawalas are financially secured.

Welfare of Dabbawalas
Insurance
The job of collecting and delivering Tiffin Boxes is a highly risky endeavor undertaken by Dabbawala. Every year thousands of people die on the tracks of Mumbai local trains. In the unfortunate incident of accident of Dabbawala, their families have to undergo an extreme financial hardship which devastates them financially.

In order to sort out this problem, Dabbawala Enterprises Private Limited offers RS. 10,00,000 (10 Lakhs) insurance policy to Dabbawalas. This ensures that in the unfortunate event of an accident, the families of Dabbawalas are financially secured.
